query:
UPDATE media_attachments
        SET transcript = $3,
            caption_vtt = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE caption_vtt END,
            decorative = $6,
            audio_described = $7,
            visuals_conveyed_in_audio = $8
        WHERE id = $1 AND account_id = $2 AND status_id IS NULL
        RETURNING id
